## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make race` (when concurrency, streaming, lifecycle, or shared state changed)
- [ ] `make production-deploy-check` (when deployment/configuration changed)
- [ ] `make docs-website` (when public documentation changed)
- [ ] Relevant live or focused test described below

## Public impact

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Public docs updated, or no public behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, or no release-note-worthy behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, private traffic, or unrelated changes included
- [ ] Public fields/routes/errors/flags/metrics have normative references and compatibility notes
- [ ] Examples state prerequisites, expected output, failure behavior, and cleanup
- [ ] Security, fixtures, operations, and release impact were considered
